name: Onboard the identity verification vendor
description: Buy document and liveness verification rather than build it: the vendor tenancy, the gateway, the private path to the vendor, and the webhook listener that hands results back to the identity service.
notes: The second vendor onboarding, and the first on the Azure landing zone over a private path.

name: Build installment lending on AWS
description: Stand up the installment lending product on the AWS landing zone: the edge and load balancer, the web and API tiers, the database, the object store, the async worker and the integration hub that fronts the ledger, the bureau and the CRM.
notes: Ends a quarter before the product launch date so there is a quarter of parallel running against the card estate.

name: Curate lending performance in BigQuery
description: The first data product on the Google Cloud side: point-of-sale finance's events curated nightly into BigQuery in an analytics project of its own, served through Looker and registered in Collibra. The second workload project on the hub, so the product's tenancy and its analytics tenancy are separate.
notes: Two systems of ours, a dataset and a project; nothing live touched. The source is the product's own event publisher, so the pipeline waits on point-of-sale finance going live.

name: Assemble the merchant portal on Azure
description: The merchant portal from the library's parts: the API, the web channel, the datastore, the event publisher, and the onboarding analyst role the product creates. Assembled as one product file with no shape; the landing zone answers for the gateway, the cluster, the database and the bus.
notes: Four new systems and a role, nothing live touched. The first project assembled from parts; its compose block is the whole architecture.

name: Buy affordability data for point-of-sale finance
description: Open banking affordability from TrueLayer, reached over Private Service Connect from the lending project on Google Cloud and returning its assessment by webhook: the vendor shape's private path and webhook return, resolved against Google Cloud for the first time. Our side is a gateway, an egress and a listener beside the point-of-sale API.
notes: Three systems of ours and the vendor's, all new; nothing live touched. The long-lead item is the private path, which the zone's Private Service Connect already provides.

name: Land point-of-sale finance on Google Cloud
description: The first product on the Google Cloud landing zone: the API, the web channel, the datastore and the event publisher of the digital shape, resolved against GKE, Apigee, Cloud SQL and Pub/Sub. The dealer integrations that start an application already run through Apigee, so the product lands beside its partners.
notes: Four new systems on a third cloud, nothing live touched. The landing zone is nineteen services the zone owners stand up once; the product is a handful of answers on the shape.

name: Stand up the regulatory reporting engine
description: Replace the spreadsheet-based return with an engine sourcing from the warehouse, and extend the customer semantic layer with the fields the return needs.
notes: Agreed and funded, not started, which is what Planned means here and what Active means on the two above it.

name: Build rewards redemption on Azure
description: The first product on the Azure digital shape: the catalog and redemption web front end and API, the product datastore, the event publisher, and the worker that fulfills a redemption after the response. Balances stay with the proposed rewards ledger; this is the channel in front of it.
notes: Five new systems and nothing live touched. The worker asked the Azure landing zone for an event stream it did not have; Event Hubs was added to the landing zone for this package, which is the only thing about it that is not a shape and a handful of answers.

name: Onboard the screening vendor
description: Buy sanctions and adverse-media screening rather than build it: the vendor tenant, the integration gateway, the private egress path and the identity federation, plus the change to the authorization switch that calls it.
notes: The only work package that changes a live system rather than only building new ones, which is why the switch appears with effect Changes.
